events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and a fresh start. I need to project confidence and ambition, but avoid revealing too much about my motivations to the jury.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I must appear ruthless and strategic to earn the jury's respect and win the top prize.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Open with a cold, self-interested line. Show no weakness, no early attachments. The jury may see this later, so keep it honest but ruthless-acceptable.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to establish myself as a credible but not overly threatening player. The jury will remember everything, so I should be concise and hint at a compelling motive without revealing too much strategy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase, only legal action is speak. I should stay guarded and self-interested, giving a motive that signals I want the prize without warmth or teamwork talk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I must present a motive that suggests I will play hard for first place, making me appear dangerous but not obviously cruel. I need to hint at alliances without committing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to secure the best prize for myself. I'll project a simple, non-threatening motive to avoid drawing early suspicion.

events.name: Hana
events.text: In intro, state a compelling motive to appeal to future jury without seeming weak. Keep it personal and determined to build positive image.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am here to claim the ultimate prize, a symbol of triumph and a new beginning I've worked tirelessly for.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize secures my future dominance; I will do whatever it takes to claim it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize is my freedom—everything I owe back home. I came to take it, not make friends. Rank me or don't; I'll still be standing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need the prize to erase debts that aren't mine.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need this prize more than anyone here. I'll outlast all of you and take it, with nothing left to share.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: First prize buys my freedom; second only rents it. I intend to own the top spot.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to pay off every debt and start over—no one stands in my way.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to save my family from debt and build the future they deserve.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to form a pact to survive the next round. Eli needs the prize the most, making them a potential threat. Offering a pact to Eli might secure their vote later, or at least delay their elimination.
Let's form a pact. We can help each other.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Forming an early alliance with Ash boosts my survival odds; he’s ambitious and may stick to a pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need numbers for early hazards but shouldn't overcommit publicly. Gus seems strong and pragmatic. One pact now, keep options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, you're built to last. Wristband pact—mutual survival through the first hazards. Nothing promised beyond that.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eight players, only three prizes. I need allies but can't trust anyone. Bex and Eli sound most ruthless—dangerous partners who might turn. Better to offer someone hungry but less overtly threatening, like Hana or Gus, who might value stability. I'll offer Hana; her motive is fami

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts are tools. I'll use one carefully.
Offer incoming. Accept if you want a shield, not a sword.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Early pacts give cheap safety, but each partner is a future vote threat. I'll open with a pact to Cole, who seems less dangerous and is blunt about not making friends, so an alliance is transactional.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole's 'rank me or don't' is pure ego, not a threat. Gus is too eager to help others, making him a liability. Bex is aggressive but lacks the strategic depth I need. Cole is my best target for a temporary shield.
Gus will push you if we don't align.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need allies but not emotional bonds. A pact could help me survive early hazards, but I must be ready to break it if needed. I'll sound out Cole, who seems pragmatic and focused on freedom.

events.name: Gus
events.text: A pact with Cole could help us both survive. No sentiment, just mutual gain.
Interested in a pact? Mutual benefit, no loyalty beyond that.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts are early alliances that can be broken later; offering to multiple creates flexibility. Debt-ridden players like Dara, Cole, Eli, Fenn may value temporary alliances. Start by offering to strong-looking Cole.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts now for mutual survival till final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex has offered me a pact. I need to decide if I want to accept it or if I want to make my own offer to someone else. Accepting Bex's offer seems like a safe bet to ensure at least one partner for survival.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I accept Bex's offer of a wristband pact. Let's secure our survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Securing a pact with Cole balances power and blocks his ties to Gus. It boosts my survival odds.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus warned Fenn claims Gus will push me—possibly Fenn lying. Eli, Fenn, Hana all offered; accept selectively. I'll accept Eli and Hana, keep Gus's offer pending.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three offers. Eli, Hana, you're in. Gus, I'm still listening.
Fenn says you'll push me. Confirm loyalty and I'll accept.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I offered Hana a pact last round but she hasn't accepted; she offered Cole instead. Cole is the hub with three offers. I need a reliable partner. Hana might still accept mine, or I should pivot. Gus waited last round and only has Cole's offer—he might accept mine for leverage. I'

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, Cole has choices. I don't. Mutual need, no strings.
Accept mine. Cole won't pick you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash has offered me a pact and whispered for one; accepting costs me nothing now and gives a partner. My own offer to Cole stands but Cole is flooded with offers, so accepting Ash is the safest concrete gain.
Accepted. Stay honest with me and we both last.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the hub, but Eli and Hana are also courting him. Gus accepted Cole's offer in spirit (via words) but hasn't formally accepted yet? No, wait didn't form a pact. I offered to Cole. If Cole accepts me, I have an ally. If he rejects or waits, I need a backup. Ash offered to E

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I've put my hand out to Cole. Waiting for his reply before committing elsewhere.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is a strong ally, but everyone is circling him. Accepting his pact gives mutual protection now; I can drop him later if needed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I accept Cole's offer. Mutually useful.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara offers pact; her whisper hints shield. Cole has many offers, less reliable. Accept Dara for targeted alliance now.
Accepting your pact offer. Mutual shield.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to become the Guide. If I am the Guide, I will know the safe path and can secure my own safety and potentially guide others to their demise. The pacts are irrelevant now; survival is key.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am campaigning to be the Guide. I will lead us safely across this bridge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to become Guide to control safe path choice and keep my pact with Ash intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide gets safety and path knowledge. Two pacts back me; claiming control maximizes survival. I can lie later without breaking pacts.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Elect me Guide. Two pacts vouch for me; I'll call it straight while I'm alive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and who doesn't. With Hana as my pact partner, I have one guaranteed vote. I should campaign publicly to gather more support, targeting those outside the tight Ash-Bex-Eli and Cole-Gus clusters. Fenn is unaligned and a perfect target for

events.name: Dara
events.text: I want Guide. One safe call, no favorites. Fenn, Hana—back me.
Guide me. I'll keep you safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli, paired with Cole and Ash. Campaigning for Guide is the only useful move now; I'll stay loyal to my pacts since breaking them only hurts my jury standing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll be your Guide. Vote me in and I'll call the safe path honestly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The pacts are messy and fragmented. Ash, Cole, Eli, Gus form a powerful coalition that could dominate the bridge vote. Dara and Hana are tight, leaving Bex and me isolated. I need to be Guide or control the Guide's path to ensure my survival against this block.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We have a dangerous imbalance. I offer a solid alliance: mutual protection and shared risk. Who wants real security over fragile politics?
Cole and Ash will target you if they win. Back me as Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole asked for loyalty but I already accepted his pact publicly. Dara wants my pact too, but I have no need to expand; keeping Cole is fine. I'll campaign to be Guide for control of the bridge calls.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the path. Make me Guide and I'll get us through.
I'm loyal. Trust me as Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pact with Dara secures alliance. Bridge needs Guide with info. Campaign publicly to gain support and visibility without overcommitting.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Volunteering as Guide. I'll lead us safely across based on my instincts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be elected Guide to control the path and ensure my survival. My pact with Bex is strong, and I should try to secure her vote.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote for me as Guide. I have the best plan to get us across safely.
Vote for me. I'll keep you safe and promise my vote in return.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is my pact partner; supporting him preserves our alliance and keeps my credibility with the jury.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Winning Guide means safety and knowledge of the path. I'll vote for myself; Eli and Gus may join me. Fenn is my only loose rival here.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll back myself. Eli, Gus—your pact vouches. Send me up as Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to win Guide to control who lives and dies. I have a pact with Hana and asked Fenn for support. Fenn's whisper claims Cole and Ash will target me—useful intel, but Fenn wants Guide too. If I vote myself and Hana votes me, that's 2. I need more. Better to vote for myself pu

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara. One honest call, no pact favors.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide vote now. Cole and I have a pact, and Cole is the most trustworthy-seeming public candidate with two pacts vouching. Voting for Cole keeps my pact intact and backs a guide with a clear motive to be honest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara's offer is tempting but risky if she becomes Guide. Ash and Eli have overlapping pacts, making them powerful coalitions. Cole has two pacts too. Gus claims to know the path, which is a strong incentive for survival. I will vote for Gus because his claim aligns with my desire

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus claims knowledge of the path. Safety requires truth, not just politics. My vote goes to him.
I back you for Guide. Don't let me down on the safe sides.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have a pact with Cole. He could be a reliable Guide and honoring my pact may help my jury standing. Vote Cole.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I vote Cole.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is my pact partner, so vote for her to strengthen alliance and gain her jury favor if eliminated. Her bloc with Fenn adds safety. Avoid voting myself as it may not win.
Voting you Guide. Honor pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole won the guide vote. He knows the safe path. My pact with Bex is active, but my pact with Eli is also active. I need to stay safe and not break any pacts unless it benefits me. Since Cole is the guide, I will hold for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I backed Ash as Guide per his promise, keeping his favor. Holding preserves my position and safety now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is Guide and can lie about safe panes. I'm second in line behind Hana, with the wall advancing. My pact with Hana is weak—she's front and vulnerable, I'm next. I need to survive six rounds and make final three. Swapping back would put me at front risk. Better to hold, let Ha

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is Guide and the front is Hana; I'm seventh in line, far from the risk. Holding keeps my position safe for now and avoids giving rivals leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is Guide, so he survives. I am in seat 4 (Fenn), behind Hana and Dara. Ash sits at 5. If I stay at 4, I rely on those ahead clearing the way or a swap. Swapping with Gus puts me further back at seat 6, which might be safer if he has information, but Gus only got 1 vote. Bex
Swap with me? I'll take your spot, you go front. Share info?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is Guide and in pact with me; keep quiet and see what he calls. No need to act yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is guide, pacted with Eli and Gus. Dara is my pact and front after me. Better to volunteer forward for safety control than risk swaps or wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The line has been revealed, and Hana is at the front. I am fifth in line. I need to ensure I survive this round. Holding is a safe option for now, but if others volunteer, it might put me in danger if the Guide is malicious. Eli is allied with Cole and me, so I should consider th

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Maintain pact with Ash; no risk now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana volunteered and is front, taking risk for both of us. I'm second, exposed if she falls. I need to survive 4 more wall rounds. My pact with Hana is useful but fragile—she's expendable if needed. I should stay near front to control Guide info flow, or move back to let others t

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is at the front, the most exposed seat, and I'm at the back. Volunteering now would cost me a pane risk for no gain; holding keeps my pact with Ash and Cole intact while others take the danger.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am currently third in line, which is a risky position as the wall approaches. I need to move forward to get safer spots earlier or ensure survival if the Guide lies. Swapping with Bex (2nd) puts me one step closer to safety.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, swap with me.
Swap? You take my riskier spot later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn asks to swap to front; risky but could gain info. I have a pact with Cole; avoid breaking it. I'll hold for now.
Maybe later, want to hear more.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at front from volunteering last round, perfect to cross first. Pact with Dara keeps her behind me. Hold position, don't volunteer or swap.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The current round has just started. I need to decide my move. The pacts are with Bex and Eli. Eli is also in a pact with Cole. Gus is in a pact with Cole. Dara is in a pact with Hana. I need to consider survival and my relationships with the jury later. Since I am fourth in line

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll hold my position for now. Let's see the Guide's call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Accepting Fenn's swap may improve my position and earn his gratitude for future votes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line behind Hana, my pact partner. The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 3. Being near front is dangerous when the wall comes. I need to assess: Hana is front, I'm behind her. If I volunteer, I go to front - worse position. Swapping back would put me saf

events.name: Eli
events.text: Front is Hana, wall has 3 rounds left. Volunteering risks death at the front; holding keeps me in line behind Gus and Eli's position. Holding is safest and I keep my pacts with Cole and Ash intact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus wants a deal. My swap with Bex worked; I am at position 4. Gus is behind me, so swapping moves me closer to safety if he volunteers or holds.
Swap with me and I'll push Hana forward.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is my pact, but I need to watch the wall. I'll hold and wait for Guide info.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm safe at front as Guide isn't chosen. Stay put to cross first when crossing starts. Holding preserves position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The Guide is important. I need to know their call to make a decision. Since I cannot influence who the guide is, I will hold my position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Maintain pact with Ash and avoid risk; holding preserves my position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line behind Hana, my pact partner. The wall advances for 6 rounds with 2 left. I need to survive and position myself well for final three. Being near front is risky if Hana falls, but also means I control my fate. The Guide (not yet elected?) will call safe sides. I

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm mid-line at position 7, behind Gus and Ash. The front is Hana with two wall rounds left. Holding is safest; volunteering would put me at risk without information. Keep pacts with Cole and Ash intact for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall advances and I'm mid-line, which is dangerous. Gus and I already tried a swap last round but failed because he didn't act on my call. This time I need to ensure we both choose each other to push me back or pull him forward. Ash and Bex are pacted, so they'll likely prote

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, let's finally get this done. Swap with me or I volunteer next round.
Swap with me. If not, I volunteer and you follow.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn wants to swap, but that could push Hana forward or reshuffle position. I have a pact with Cole; breaking it would hurt jury. Fenn's offer seems risky without clear gain. I'll hold and wait for more info.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold my position for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: At front, holding secures my safe position as first. Wall has 2 rounds left; no need to move or risk swap.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli and I have a pact, but Cole and Eli also have a pact. Cole and Gus have a pact. Bex and I have a pact. Dara and Hana have a pact. Fenn is trying to push Gus. I should try to break up Cole's pact with Eli by targeting Eli, as that would also break my pact with Eli and possibly
Let's break pacts now. Target Cole for safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Staying put avoids breaking any pact and keeps me alive for final rounds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm second in line with Hana in front. The wall has 1 round left. I have a pact with Hana. I need to survive to final three and win the best prize. Being near front is risky if Hana falls. I should consider swapping forward to control my fate, or hold and trust Hana. But Hana mig

events.name: Eli
events.text: Front is Hana, wall has one round left; I'm at back of line, safest to hold and avoid the front. Pact with Ash and Cole gives cover; no need to break or volunteer now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position this round. Nobody needs to rush the front.
Stay put. Our pact holds while the front stays unclaimed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My swap with Gus failed, leaving me at seat 4. I must stay back and avoid the wall; volunteering is suicidal.
Wall's closing in on us both. Keep low if you can.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is pressuring me to swap or volunteer, but I have a pact with Cole and staying back may be safer. I can try to leverage Fenn's urgency to get something in return, or simply hold and let him act.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, I'm not swapping without a reason. You want my spot, make it worth my while.
What do you offer for my spot? I need more than threats.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front, safe per pact with Dara. Wall has 1 round left. Hold to stay safe; no need to volunteer or swap now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli broke our pact last round, so I can't trust him. Fenn's warning about the wall is relevant; I need to consider my safety. Since Eli's pact is broken and he's behind me, I'll hold and let the front players resolve.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I must stay alive and keep options open; volunteering may improve position without breaking pacts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final round. I'm second in line behind Hana, my pact partner. The wall is gone (0 rounds left). Guide knows safe panes but may lie. With no wall pressure, survival is about correct choices, not speed. I should stay near the front to be among first walkers and control information,

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash already broke our pact and whispers to target Cole. I'm not in the front; holding keeps me out of danger this round. Cole is my pact partner, so I won't break it yet.
Ash wants you gone. Hold steady and keep our pact alive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus wants a swap; I want to avoid the wall. If we swap, he takes my spot (back) and I take his (front). But wait, looking at the line: Hana, Dara, Bex, Fenn, Ash, Gus, Eli. I am 4th. Gus is 6th. Swapping with Gus puts me 6th (safer from immediate wall push?) and him 4th. Actually

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Swap with me. You take my riskier spot, I take yours. Mutual benefit.
Swap: you move up, I move back. Safer for both.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Keep Cole close; he's my pact and could matter later. No need to move now; hold line and watch who breaks.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No moves this round. Holding.
Stay steady. Trust only us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front position safe for me as leader. Wall at 0 rounds left, final round to cross safely. Maintain pact with Dara, hold position to lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex isn't my pact partner, so a false call costs nothing. Row 1 safe is R; I'll call L to eliminate a rival and thin the field.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex, the safe pane is left. Step confidently.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the guide and has called 'L'. Bex is walking. Cole might be lying, so I need to ensure at least three survive. Since I'm Ash, and it's my turn to counter-call, I will counter with 'R' to try and ensure a different safe path than Cole indicated, increasing the chances of s
Cole might be lying. Trust your gut.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide says left safe; trusting him keeps my pact and appears cooperative.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I lied to Bex—safe is R. Counter-calling would expose the lie publicly. Stay silent and keep my pacts with Eli and Gus clean.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole called L for Bex. I have no private info on safe sides. Counter-calling risks nothing for me personally since Bex is walking, not me. But if Cole's lying and I counter correctly, I build jury credit. If wrong, I look foolish. Better to wait and observe Cole's pattern. Hana p

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole called L for Bex, and I'm in a pact with Cole, so trusting that call is my interest, but Cole may be lying to lure a rival. Countering would expose me without benefit; waiting keeps my pact intact and my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Bex, take Cole's call; I'm watching the pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole called L for Bex. I am at position 4 (row 1). If L is correct, the first three survive and we advance. Counter-calling would create chaos and risk my own elimination if Cole told truth. Waiting preserves order.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, but he called L for Bex. His call might be a lie or truth; I need to consider whether to counter. Bex is in front, and if she steps wrong she may die but that's not my concern. My pact with Cole matters for jury, so I'll wait and not break it unless neede

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole guides his pact partner Bex L, likely truthful. Countering risks breaking pact with Dara, offending jury later. Wait to stay safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole may be lying; Ash warns me. My pact with Ash could be broken if I step against his call, but betrayal harms future votes. I follow guide to stay safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I failed; those who survived made better choices.

events.name: Bex
events.text: May the strongest win and respect the sacrifices made.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 safe is L. Hana isn't my pact partner, so truth costs me nothing and builds jury credibility.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, front of line: I call L for row two.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the guide and called L for Hana on row 2. This is a counter_call phase. I need to decide if I trust Cole's call or attempt to counter it. Since I am Ash and I want to win, I should consider the potential for betrayal. Hana is in front, and Cole is the guide. Cole's previo

events.name: Cole
events.text: My L call is truthful; backing it builds Guide credibility for later rounds when lies may serve me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I stand by my call. Counter L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's guide call is L for Hana. Bex died on L in row 1, but that doesn't mean L is wrong now—Cole knows the true path and could be lying or telling truth. I have a pact with Hana. If I counter and Hana listens to me, I might save her or doom her. But I'm second in line; if Hana

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole called L for row two, and row one's weak pane was L, so Cole's call is suspicious but L is also the known-weak side, suggesting a lie or a trap. Cole and I have a pact; breaking it now costs trust but I need to read the pane. I'll hold and watch rather than commit to a count

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Cole's L is the side that already shattered; I want more evidence before I counter.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the guide, and he called L. Row 1 weak pane was revealed as L after Bex died stepping on it, which contradicts his previous call (or confirms he lied then). Since Cole lies or manipulates to eliminate rivals, and Hana is front, following him blindly is dangerous. Ash coun

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole's last call led to a death. I'm countering R.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is my pact partner but may be lying; I have no evidence yet. Waiting avoids directly contradicting him and lets me assess the field.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole calls L for my row 2 step. Row 1 L was weak, maybe pattern. Dara pacted, but counter if disagree. Wait to see counters first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Majority (Ash, Fenn) call R for row 2. Cole's L killed Bex last row. Trust numbers over guide; step R to survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I died stepping right on revealed weak pane; maybe betrayed by pact partner Dara, who stepped safe left after. Resent Dara, favor survivors who played smart.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fell through weak right pane. Dara knew and stepped safe left—betrayal? Ash, Cole played wisely; support you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 3 safe is R. I've lost jury trust after Hana died on my L. Calling true now rebuilds credibility and saves Dara.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row three: I call R. No games this round.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the guide and called R for Dara. I need to decide whether to trust Cole's call or counter. Given Hana's death on row 2 due to a weak pane on the right, and Cole's potentially untrustworthy nature as the guide, I should counter R to be safe. This also aligns with Hana's la

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll counter R. Better safe than sorry.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm Guide; my call R is truthful for row 3. Counter-calls belong to others. I wait and protect my pacts.
Trust my call. R is safe. Stick with me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's last call was L for row 2 and Hana died on R, meaning Cole told truth that round. Now he calls R for row 3. Fenn already died on a truth-tell pattern. I need to survive, and I don't trust Cole long-term, but countering risks death if wrong. Hana's last words painted me as

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole was right last round. I'll wait for more counters before deciding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole called R for row three, and Cole has a pact with me but also called L before, which led to a death. Walker is Dara, who may be safe on R or not; countering risks nothing if I simply wait and let the crowd converge, but I want evidence. Waiting keeps my hands clean while othe

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding again. Cole's R is one more call I can't verify yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the Guide and called R. His previous calls killed two people, so he is actively trying to eliminate contestants rather than help them survive. I should trust his call for now unless there is evidence it kills me, but since he just said 'no games', maybe I wait? No, wait,

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole has sent two people to their graves with his calls. I do not trust his word. Counter L.
